doc.description: Common functionality of Aspirin v2 IMUs. The Aspirin IMU can be used on different flight controllers. Most commonly used onboard a Lisa M(X) v2.1 FC, but IMU can be connected over SPI to other flight controllers as well. The Aspirin IMU consists of: - Accelerometer and Gyro: MPU6000 connected over SPI. - Magnetometer: HMC5883 as I2C slave of the MPU6000 Acc/gyro. - Barometer: ms5611 connected over SPI as well, but this is not handled by this module, but by the barometer module.
